headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 1.01 (95% CI: 0.99–1.03), indicating no statistically significant association between omega-6 fatty acids and prostate cancer. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
